name: Aerodyne
description: Developer of a DT3 (drone technology, data technology & digital transformation) enterprise solutions provider designed for large-scale data operations, analytics, and process optimization. The company's platform offers a wide range of infant goods that include but are not limited to diapers, wipes, skin care, oral care and cleaning products made from quality materials and ingredients, enabling customers to have access to affordable premium baby-care goods.

name: Asaak
description: Developer of a mobile-based microfinance platform designed to democratize financial services and help businesses grow with confidence. The company's platform manages lending operations, underwriting, application processing, investor management, and loan servicing, enabling clients to access various digital finance tools to reach customers.

name: AtomX
description: Operator of an online advertising platform intended to allow advertisers, publishers, and intermediaries to control each impression. The company's platform offers an online marketplace that connects networks, demand-side platforms, supply-side platforms, and other parties and features pre- and post-bid fraud detection algorithms, advanced reports, and a control panel, enabling businesses to eliminate all fraud pre-bid and exercise full control over their advertisements.

name: Avant
description: Operator of a homegrown brand intended to offer halal personal care products. The company specializes in skincare and cosmetics enabling it to offer all-natural, non-inflammatory, non-toxic, and effective ingredients to address various skin concerns, enabling consumers to get quality skincare products.

name: Bayapay Sdn Bhd
description: Provider of a smart fuel fleet payment & fleet management platform intended to help commercial vehicle owners deter fraud, save cost, and digitize fleet management. The company offers a fully functional open-loop payment card to save money and stay ahead of the competition, enabling businesses to make secure payments within set limits and controls across all fleet-related expenses with ease.

name: Qapital OS
description: Developer of an online payment gateway platform designed to initiate automated and cashless bill payment services. The company's platform offers a secure payment portal where users can share confidential bank details to send bills and collect payments in real-time, enabling users to transact money securely.

name: Braintree
description: Provider of drone services intended to bring precision and automation to agriculture. The company provides drone services and AI-powered computer vision algorithms and technologies in mapping, evaluation, design & planning, database development, and analysis for agricultural entities, enabling the agricultural industry to process satellite remote sensing data for searching new suitable land for plantation.

name: Brandripe
description: Operator of a creative service agency intended to provide graphic design services. The company's agency provides advertising materials, web design, social media graphics and illustrations with unlimited design requests and revisions and vetted professional designers, enabling businesses to receive designs at a flat monthly fee.

name: Carsome
description: Operator of an online car-selling platform intended to connect customers to used car dealers. The company offers a range of services that include car inspection, ownership transfer to financing as well as offers a curated selection of cars to individuals who wish to buy pre-owned cars, enabling customers to sell cars within a day with no fee and no hassle.

name: Catch that bus
description: Developer of a mobile ticket booking application designed to help book bus tickets online. The company's application connects passengers to express bus operators where users can browse through and purchase tickets from a range of trusted operators to various destinations in Malaysia and Singapore, enabling users to book bus tickets directly with bus operators at their own convenience.

The company provides comprehensive information and comparison tools, translates education jargon into relevant content, provides recommendations and counseling and helps to compare courses, enabling students to make informed decisions about their college selection and obtain the right college education.

name: Ejen2u
description: Developer of a reseller ecosystem platform intended to help business owners manage resellers like stockists, agents, and dropships. The company's platform is integrated, digitalized, and data-driven and offers systematic product ordering, detailed reporting, commissions, reward systems, databases, and performance monitoring among others, enabling businesses to improve productivity and profitability.

name: Ekomoditi
description: Developer of a plantation management software designed to increase the palm oil plantation. The company's software helps to simplify the record of plantation management, improve efficiency, reduce cost, increase productivity and monitor some aspects of the problems that have the potential to cause losses, enabling farmers to access information about different phases of the plantation.

name: EMTECH
description: Developer of cloud-based software designed to provide central banks with scalable and resilient digital infrastructure. The company offers digital regulatory sandboxes for multi-party collaborative workflows, digital cash, and digital currency integrators for cross-border integration among others, enabling central banks to modernize operations and improve efficiency.

name: Food Market Hub
description: Operator of a procurement and inventory management platform intended to help restaurants to control purchasing. The company's platform offers features like central kitchen management, integration with accounting and POS, notification via various mediums, and inventory management, enabling clients to easily integrate the entire value chain from the farm to the restaurant.

name: GoGet
description: Developer of a demand workforce platform designed to offer reliable and skilled manpower. The company's platform transforms the traditional labor market, no longer do people have to choose only between a full-time job or an eight-hour working shift, enabling businesses to grow their operations with a dynamic on-demand workforce to increase productivity and save costs.

name: ARG
description: Operator of a social e-commerce site for action sports based in San Francisco, California. The company provides its community with a curated selection of established and upcoming outdoor lifestyle brands.

name: Halogen Capital
description: Developer of a digital platform designed to help investors gain exposure safely to the new asset classes. The company specializes in digital assets and combines traditional capital market expertise with deep technology knowledge, enabling clients to access digital assets, and help with private key management, tax uncertainties, and inconsistent fund reporting.

name: iCart
description: Operator of an online grocery service designed for an easy grocery shopping experience. The company helps to shop all products from local grocery stores around the city to deliver a simplified life, enabling customers to purchase groceries without having to worry about their freshness.

name: Hello Gold
description: Developer of a shariah-compliant mobile application designed to change the way users buy, save, sell, and redeem physical gold. The company's platform allows users to purchase and store gold online or take physical possession of the gold which can be sold at the prevailing exchange rates, enabling users to take a step toward lifelong financial security.

name: HelprNow
description: Operator of an online marketplace platform intended to assist customers in purchasing gifts. The company offers gifts for all kinds of occasions as well as provides customized gifts, along with recommendations of places to visit or dine for various events, enabling users to put a personal touch on gifts and purchase them at a low cost.

name: iMotorbike
description: Operator of a motorcycle marketplace intended to transform motorcycle sales in Southeast Asia. The company's marketplace offers a wide selection of motorcycles from a variety of brands and models and also provides a search engine that makes it easy to find motorcycles by make, model and location, enabling motorbike owners and two-wheeler enthusiasts to have a comprehensive motorcycle database that provides information about the same and find the suitable motorcycle for their needs.

name: Instanture
description: Our suite of AI SAAS help brand & distributor to manage their order & pay operation across multiple sales channels

name: Involve Asia
description: Developer of a digital marketing platform designed to help both brands and partners to scale their online earnings. The company's platform affiliates marketing and maximizes earnings through intelligent product and service recommendations, enabling brands to grow through effective marketing partnerships with content creators, developers and affiliates across the world.

name: Kaodim
description: Operator of a home service platform intended to help users to find out the right vendor for their job requests. The company's platform depending on the service required by the users sends the quotes or assigns them to a vendor at a fixed price for house cleaning, plumbing, air conditioner servicing, and other related services, enabling customers to find a service provider according to their everyday needs.

name: LottieFiles
description: Developer of an animation workflow platform designed to create a new realm of possibilities with interactive design. The company focuses on building an open-source animation file format that is tiny, interactive, and can be manipulated at runtime as well as helps to create interactive motion graphics that make products stand out, enabling motion designers, developers, and marketers to increase engagement by grabbing and holding user attention.

name: Meals In Minutes, MIM
description: Provider of ready-to-cook frozen meals intended to deliver food with convenience with the subscription. The company delivers portioned and prepped meals that are easy to prepare, comprising a variety of bases, sides, proteins, and even a burger, enabling starved individuals, mothers, and working couples to enjoy premium, halal, and healthy meals without spending much time on meal preparation.

name: MHub
description: Developer of a real-estate fin-tech platform designed for property developers, agents and bankers. The company's platform brings together real estate developers, sales teams, bankers, lawyers and buyers, enabling clients to avoid long and arduous property sales journeys.

name: Omvana
description: Operator of an education investment group intended to build and invest in education businesses. The company publishes ideas and teachings by good authors in personal growth, wellbeing, spirituality, productivity, mindfulness and more and combines them with cutting-edge sophisticated learning technology, thereby helping users with their growth.

name: Neuroware.io
description: Developer of blockchain applications designed to properly leverage the benefits of distributed ledger technologies. The company's applications develop a range of specialized non-financial protocols for the blockchains and open-source e-wallet technology that runs entirely in the browser and can be embedded into anything that supports local storage, as well as the services, combine on-chain data storage, decentralized identity, and authentication and public key logistics, enabling clients to get training, education, and awareness for exploring blockchain technology.

name: NEXT Academy
description: Operator of a digital marketing and coding school intended to learn digital marketing. The company's school offers nine weeks of coding boot camps and digital marketing courses designed by industry experts and benchmarked against world standards, enabling aspiring entrepreneurs, freelancers, and software engineers to easily become code developers and digital marketers in life.

name: Nikahsatu
description: Operator of Malaysia’s largest wedding venue network, offering affordable full-service wedding packages that include venues, catering, photography, décor, and stationery. Nikahsatu provides a one-stop platform that simplifies wedding planning for modern couples, supported by strong social media reach and data-driven marketing.

name: Nizthewiz
description: Developer of a delivery application designed to offer same day logistics and courier services. The company's application provides crowd-sourced courier fleet providing full transparency of the last mile delivery cycle which empowers users with live GPS tracking for all deliveries every step, enabling e-commerce and logistics industry to directly communicate their requirements and manage their own outcomes.

name: Notti
description: Operator of an online store intended to change the pet industry in Malaysia. The company offers slow-baked, grain-free kibbles made with protein content and human-grade fresh meat designed to support pet health and wellness, enabling owners to provide healthy food option to their pets.

name: Shoppr
description: Developer of a data analytics platform designed to provide data to fashion brands. The company platform allows fashion businesses to manage market trends and insights, manage product demand, materials, colours and styles as well as offers real-time market intelligence data to fashion brands globally, enabling brands to find and target leads and helping in customer acquisition and retention.

name: Pandai
description: Developer of a learning application designed for students to get better grades in school. The company's application provides gamified quizzes aligned to a specific school curriculum, practice questions, and learning materials, enabling students to learn, practice, get feedback, and diagnose weaknesses through a fun and engaging learning experience.

name: Plant Cartridge
description: Operator of an agriculture technology company intended to offer sustainable micro-urban farming systems. The company's growing kit consists of a box of cartridges that contain selected seeds and the growing medium and a rectangular ultraviolet-coated polyethylene tank, with a hole in the center for topping up the water for the plants and holes to hold the pods in place, enabling people to grow their own food at home in order to solve the global food production shortage.

name: Purely B
description: Provider of an online content-based fitness and wellness portal designed to help women lead sustainable and healthy lifestyle. The company's fitness and wellness portal offers articles on living written by health and wellness experts, as well as a range of healthy and wholesome recipes created by a community of nutrition experts, enabling consumers to connect and share healthy living experiences and tips with other like-minded individuals, and purchase health and wellness products from an online platform.

name: Qarbotech
description: Developer of a biocompatible technology designed to increase the photosynthesis rate in plants. The company's product is formulated with a particular organic compound that has similar properties as chlorophyll converts more photons delivers more electrons to the photo-systems and enhances the photosynthesis rate of plants by a certain margin, enabling farmers to enhance plant growth and avoid excessive chemical fertilizer usage.

name: SOLS Energy
description: Provider of solar energy products and services intended to promote the use of green energy. The company offers grid-tied, off-grid, and hybrid solar thermal and water pump systems that facilitate reducing carbon dioxide emissions, enabling customers to get cost-effective access to clean energy.

name: SpeedHome
description: Developer of a real estate platform designed to assist owners in managing tenants and properties at an affordable rate. The company's platform has a searchable database that lets users find homes and deal with landlords directly, enabling landlords to rent properties in a cheaper, faster, and easier way.

name: Storehub
description: Developer of cloud-based point-of-sale software designed to help retailers to digitize their business. The company's software develops a cloud-based point-of-sale system that offers real-time reports, inventory management, and customer data collection that help to connect the long line of less sophisticated physical traders online, enabling users to digitize their finances and inventory management.

name: SUPA
description: Developer of a data labeling platform designed to accurately label images, text, speech, and video clips. The company's platform uses artificial intelligence technology and offers Application Programming Interface (API) integration in real-time and proprietary data labeling tools, enabling businesses to deliver an accurate training dataset that is ready for use.

name: TheNoor
description: Developer of a Muslim lifestyle application designed to help users achieve their spiritual commitment. The company's application provides a modern and comprehensive on-the-go Quran player that comes with audio voice translation options in five languages aiming to bring Muslims closer to their religion through continuous learning and exposure to the teachings of Islam, enabling users to achieve their spiritual commitment by transforming how they engage with Islam.

name: TTRacing
description: Manufacturer of gaming chairs and accessories intended to provide long hours of comfort for greater productivity and performance. The company offers ergonomic gaming chairs as well as smart desks, cable organizers, cushions, casters, and many more, enabling gamers to play and enjoy games comfortably.

name: Vircle

The company's platform offers a cashless system to parents to approve instant allowances, create savings habits, and encourage responsibility through chores and tasks, enabling kids to learn and experience money safely.

name: Virtualtech Frontier

The company offers virtual solutions for any type of event including virtual exhibitions, classrooms, and conferences, live-stream events, along with some added features such as allowing visitors to take photos and edit them for social media, online payment gateway integration, enabling users to sell and carry out transactions directly from their virtual events among others.

name: Worq
description: Provider of space-as-a-service designed for companies of all sizes from fast-growing startups to multinational corporations. The company uses its on-demand office network to offer community-based workspaces, including community events, high-speed internet, virtual office setups, and private telephone booths, enabling members to discover opportunities while sharing experiences and benefit from the one-stop business center services.

name: TableApp

The company's online table booking application assists, reviews and manages reservations all-in-one, enablings users to locate, assess and reserve a table instantly with instant confirmation.
